backend/main.mo: Motoko actor providing CRUD for categories, vendors, payment methods, expenses, and revenue with access control and user profile management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature-evidence report linking frontend files to high-level feature requirements, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend React file used in the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining OKLCH-based color tokens, dark mode values, and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point containing root div and script loading the main React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router and authentication gate wiring Internet Identity, profile setup flow, and page routes.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header navigation, logout, main content container, and footer.
frontend/src/components/KpiCard.tsx: Reusable component rendering a KPI card with title, icon, formatted value, and variant-based styling.
frontend/src/components/NumericCell.tsx: Utility table cell component that right-aligns and formats numbers as currency, percent, or numeric values.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Form dialog prompting user for their name and saving the profile via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/TimeWindowSelect: Select component allowing users to choose a reporting time window.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity login state, loading identities, and exposing auth actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of react-query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, categories, vendors, and other backend data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with theme variables, light/dark modes, utility classes, and print styles.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function for merging Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that mounts React, sets up QueryClient, and wraps the app with InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CogsPage.tsx: Static page describing upcoming COGS features with an alert and planned feature list.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard showing KPIs and quick stats using fetched financial data with a selectable time window.
frontend/src/pages/ExpensesPage.tsx: Displays and manages expense records with CRUD dialogs, pulling categories, vendors, and payment methods.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides a login screen using Internet Identity with a simple sign‑in flow.
frontend/src/pages/MasterDataPage.tsx: Hosts tabs for managing categories, vendors, and payment methods with CRUD dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Shows a placeholder for upcoming financial reports and lists planned report types.
frontend/src/pages/RevenuePage.tsx: Displays and manages revenue records with CRUD dialogs, using categories for revenue classification.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting hash‑based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS themes, colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Holds project metadata, architectural notes, and a list of existing implemented features for the internal accounting web app.
